notes: Synthetic readings, not from a real test. Made by make_readings.py from Wobbl's own solution with
E = 70.6 GPa and gauge noise, to show the workflow. They say nothing about how well the model matches

headline: 16 readings from readings.csv, which are synthetic and do not come from a real test. 16 of 16 agree with the simulation within twice their validation uncertainty, and the comparison error averages -2.3% of the reading. The pooled area metric is 0.121, within the 0.145 a model with the right spread would stay under 95% of the time. The readings favour a distributed attachment over a rigid attachment by a likelihood ratio of more than 1,000, with the modulus fitted to each. Calibration puts E at 70938 MPa (95% interval 70055 to 71834 MPa, 4.8x narrower than before the test).
